messages:
maria: Wed release train planning — we'll do 10:00-14:00 PT. Need owners for two lanes: cfg-service (config service) and router-service. Also who will run smoke checks and be ready to rollback? @ajay @devin @sarah

ajay: I can take cfg-service. Prefer 10:30 slot if possible. What's the canary plan?

maria: thanks @ajay. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% after 10m -> 100% after successful smoke (reaction :eyes:)

devin: I can own router-service, but can we push it to 12:00? I have a preflight for infra at 11:00.

maria: 12:00 works — ok mark that. @release-bot can you add to the train schedule?

release-bot: added: cfg-service @ajay 10:30, router-service @devin 12:00, smoke: @sarah 10:40 and 12:10. Template:
```
10:30 cfg-service canary 5% -> 25% @10:40 smoke -> 100% if OK
12:00 router-service canary 5% -> 25% @12:10 smoke -> 100% if OK
rollback commands: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/<svc>`
```

sarah: I'll run smoke checks. My checklist:
- health endpoints
- critical e2e on staging
- latency dashboard + 95th in Grafana
Cmds I run:
```
curl -sS https://cfg.example/health | jq .status
kubectl -n prod exec -it smoke-runner -- ./run-e2e.sh --suite critical
```

jordan: quick question — any DB migrations in these lanes?

devin: None for router-service. cfg-service has non-breaking feature-flag keys only.

ajay: re: rollback — can we keep the previous image tagged `prev-release`? I'll push tag and share.

maria: yes, tagging policy stands. ajay please push `prev-release` tag by EOD today. Also post rollback steps in thread once done.

ajay: done, pushed `cfg-service:prev-release` (reaction :white_check_mark:).

sarah: I'll be on call for both canaries and will post smoke results. If anything fails I'll escalate to @maria and trigger rollback.

maria: perfect. small note: keep canaries at 5% for min 10 minutes unless critical alert. If we see slow degradation, do immediate rollback.

devin: ack. I'll hop in at 11:50 to prep the router deploy.

maria: thanks everyone — final check: @ajay @devin @sarah say "ready" when you have your runbooks and tags in place.

ajay: ready

devin: ready

sarah: ready

release-bot: reminder set 30m before each deploy window (reaction :alarm_clock:)
